attributes.action: Protect medically vulnerable people from secondhand vape exposure
attributes.additional_details: While the Government focuses on youth vaping and adult smoking cessation, they are completely neglecting medically vulnerable citizens. Under the Equality Act 2010, people with severe health conditions have a legal right to safely access public life. By leaving indoor public spaces unregulated, these individuals are forced into isolation. The UK Government must act on the substantial evidence showing that passive vaping risks the health of those with pre-existing health conditions.
attributes.background: We call on the Government to legally mandate vape-free environments across the UK. Current law leaves medically vulnerably people, like those with respiratory conditions, unable to access public transport, workplaces, or essential services without being exposed to harmful secondhand vape chemicals.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign one of the following petitions, which call for similar action: 

"Ban indoor vaping in all enclosed workplaces and enclosed public places" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/776993

"Ban vaping in indoor public places and designated outdoor public spaces." https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/777036
